name: layout-panels
summary: How panels & overlays open, move and resize. Drawer (slide-over, FlotoDrawer · 146) · Modal (a-modal · 37) · Collapsible (MCollapse · 19) · Expandable rows (9) · Resizable / split (splitpanes · ~3) · Affix / sticky · Dashboard tiles (vue-grid-layout · 5) · Bulk-action bar (fixed bottom · 2) · Popover (20+) · Full-screen / OmniBox overlay.
do: Drawer is the default record surface (forms + deep drill-downs); ESC to close.
Modal for small confirm/collect; Drawer for panel-sized records.
Bulk-action bar appears on selection; Popover for contextual, light content.
dont: Don't use resizable splits casually (rare — only settings/topology/apm trace).
Don't confuse table column-resize (a grid feature) with a panel behaviour.

a11y.summary: Behaviour references. In the product: Drawer/Modal trap focus + close on ESC; Popover is aria-described from its anchor; the Bulk-action bar announces the selection count.

knownIssues: Behaviour diagrams, not live overlays — the real components own focus-trap / ESC / aria.

[element] The obs-layout-* WEB COMPONENT is a fixed visual demo, not a slotted layout primitive — you can't put a real page inside it. Use the layout GUIDANCE (decisionFlow/regions) + compose the shell from atoms + the 12-col grid + tokens.
changelog: 2026-06-29: fixed Expandable-rows expanded header/body collapsing to content width.
whenToUse: How a surface shows up — editing a record → Drawer; a quick confirm → Modal; optional detail → Collapsible / Expandable rows; the rest are for specific jobs.
usedIn: Drawer 146 files · Modal 37 · Collapsible 19 · Popover 20+ · Expandable rows 9.
Dashboard tiles 5 · Bulk-action bar 2 · Resizable splits ~3 (settings / topology / apm trace).
Drawer is the default record surface; Modal for small confirms; Bulk-bar appears on selection.
decisionFlow: Short yes/no or destructive confirmation, or a small focused task that must center-interrupt? -> Modal (FlotoConfirmModal, variant=error for destructive; MModal for a short form). Keep it small.
A brief non-interactive hint? -> Tooltip. A small contextual menu / column-selector / rich mini-panel off a trigger? -> Popover (non-blocking).

Create/edit a record, or a panel-sized detail/drill-down contextual to a row (keep the list behind it)? -> Drawer (FlotoDrawerForm ~40% for forms; a WIDE drawer 85-96% for multi-pane flows or genuine deep dives). The product's default off-list surface.
A high-complexity record, a multi-step wizard, a settings section, or a screen that must be deep-linkable / own its route? -> a full PAGE/route (a page template), NOT a drawer or modal.
Optional, secondary detail on the current screen? -> Collapsible section or Expandable table row. Never collapse REQUIRED fields.
Other jobs: tiles in a grid -> Dashboard tiles; stick on scroll -> Affix; multi-select actions -> Bulk-action bar (appears on selection); split/resizable areas -> Resizable split.

modal.useWhen: a short confirm/collect, or a focused task that must block until answered; destructive actions (variant=error, name the verb, not Yes/OK)
modal.dontUse: long/scrollable content or anything contextual to a record -> use a Drawer; a page-sized flow -> use a route
modal.example: Delete monitor? confirm; one-time API secret; quick Add-label form

drawer.useWhen: create/edit a record or a panel-sized detail off a list; keeps the list context behind the backdrop (~40% for forms, 85-96% wide for multi-pane / genuine deep dives)
drawer.dontUse: a one-line confirm (-> Modal); a high-complexity record that deserves its own URL (-> page/route)
drawer.example: Add Monitor / Edit Policy (FlotoDrawerForm); backup-compare deep dive (wide)

page-route.useWhen: a high-complexity record, a multi-step wizard, a settings section, or anything that must be deep-linkable / keep its own route
page-route.dontUse: a quick edit off a list where a drawer keeps context better; a confirm (-> Modal)
page-route.example: a full Settings policy form (hideSettingsMenu); a Report Builder wizard

popover.useWhen: a small, non-blocking contextual panel off a trigger — action menus, column selectors, sub-tabs, rich mini-panels
popover.dontUse: a center-interrupting task/confirm (-> Modal); long content (-> Drawer)

collapsible.useWhen: optional/secondary detail on the current screen the user can reveal
collapsible.dontUse: hiding REQUIRED fields; a whole record (-> Drawer)
collapsible.example: Advanced options section; expandable table-row detail

bulk-action-bar.useWhen: actions on a multi-selection in a grid/list; appears on selection
bulk-action-bar.example: Delete Selected / Export on a checked table
